title: Rory and the Crystal Cave
verses:
As the shadows grew long over valleys of green,
Rory trotted along to the edge of the hill.
Where the prettiest blossoms were rarely yet seen,
And the evening around them was quiet and still.

Nia fluttered high up in the shimmering sky,
To discover a path that was paved with soft stone.
As she watched all the silver-tinged clouds floating by,
She called down to her friends in a musical tone.

Ricky scampered ahead with a leap and a bound,
Til he came to a cavern that glowed in the dark.
Psittaco nestled down on a mossy green mound,
Where the crystals were shining with many a spark.

Benny rested his head on the floor of the cave,
While Tilly curled up by the edge of a stream.
As the wind gave the sleepy giant trees a slow wave,
All the dinos were ready to drift in a dream.

Rory gave a big yawn as he tucked in his tail,
Listening close to the breeze as it hummed a soft song.
Over mountain and meadow and peaceful blue vale,
Where the shadows were stretching out sleepy and long.

Now the starlight was dimming the quiet night air,
And the forest was wrapped in a cozy embrace.
With his friends sleeping soundly and happily there,
Rory closed his bright eyes with a smile on his face.
